{{nihongo|'''Iwakami Yamazumi Shrine'''|石神山精神社}} is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}} located in Yoshida Aza-Fumoto, {{ill|Miyagi Prefecture|Q47896|qid=Q47896}}{{ill|Kurokawa District, Miyagi|ceb|Kurokawa-gun|fr|District de Kurokawa|id|Distrik Kurokawa, Miyagi|it|Distretto di Kurokawa|ja|黒川郡|ko|구로카와군|pl|Powiat Kurokawa|ru|Курокава (уезд)|uk|Повіт Курокава|zh|黑川郡|zh_yue|黑川郡|qid=Q1131782}}{{ill|Taiwa, Miyagi|arz|تايوا|ceb|Taiwa Chō|es|Taiwa|fa|تایوا، میاگی|fr|Taiwa|id|Taiwa, Miyagi|it|Taiwa|ja|大和町|ko|다이와정|ms|Taiwa, Miyagi|my|တိုင်းဝမြို့၊ မိယဂိ|pl|Taiwa|ru|Тайва|sv|Taiwa, Miyagi|tl|Taiwa, Miyagi|tr|Taiwa|uk|Тайва (Міяґі)|ur|ٹائیوا، میاگی|zh|大和町|zh_yue|大和町|qid=Q1205377}}.<ref name=jinjacho>{{Cite web|ja|url=http://www.miyagi-jinjacho.or.jp/jinja-search/detail.php?code=310020374|title=Iwakami Yamazumi Shrine|publisher=Miyagi Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines|accessdate=2015-04-01}}</ref> {{nihongo|'''Iwakami Yamazumi Shrine'''|石神山精神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is one of the four Shikinaisha shrines of {{ill|Kurokawa District, Miyagi|ceb|Kurokawa-gun|fr|District de Kurokawa|id|Distrik Kurokawa, Miyagi|it|Distretto di Kurokawa|ja|黒川郡|ko|구로카와군|pl|Powiat Kurokawa|ru|Курокава (уезд)|uk|Повіт Курокава|zh|黑川郡|zh_yue|黑川郡|qid=Q1131782}}, and, as indicated by its name, it is an ancient {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto The {{ill|Saijin|Q11591100|qid=Q11591100}} are Ōyamatsumi-no-Kami, Ōtoshi-no-Kami, Ōkuninushi-no-Kami, Kotoshironushi-no-Kami, Uke Mochi-no-Kami, and Kamado-no-Kami.

In front of the shrine building stands a cedar tree said by old {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=oral tradition}} to have been planted by General {{ill|Sakanoue no Tamuramaro|Q941979|qid=Q941979}}. There is also an ancient cedar with a circumference of 7 meters and an age of over 1,000 years.

== History ==
* {{ill|790|ab|790|af|790|am|790 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|790|ar|790|ary|790|ast|790|az|790|azb|۷۹۰ (میلادی)|ban|790|bcl|790|be|790|be_x_old|790|bg|790|bn|৭৯০|bpy|মারি ৭৯০|br|790|bs|790.|ca|790|cdo|790 nièng|ceb|790|ckb|٧٩٠|crh|790|cs|790|cv|790|cy|790|da|790|de|790|el|790|eml|790|eo|790|es|790|et|790|eu|790|fa|۷۹۰ (میلادی)|fi|790|fo|790|fr|790|fy|790|ga|790|gan|790年|gd|790|gl|790|he|790|hi|790|hr|790.|ht|790 (almanak jilyen)|hu|790|hy|790|id|790|io|790|is|790|it|790|ja|790年|jv|790|ka|790|kk|790 жыл|ko|790년|la|790|lb|790|lij|790|lmo|790|lt|790 m.|lv|790. gads|map_bms|790|mdf|790|mg|790|mhr|790|mk|790|mr|इ.स. ७९०|mrj|790 и|ms|790|mzn|۷۹۰|nah|790|nap|790|nds|790|new|सन् ७९०|nl|790|nn|790|no|790|nrm|790|nso|790|oc|790|or|୭୯୦|os|790-æм аз|pl|790|pnb|790|pt|790|qu|790|ro|790|ru|790 год|rue|790|sa|७९०|scn|790|sd|790ع|sh|790.|shn|790|si|790|sk|790|sl|790|sq|790|sr|790|su|790|sv|790|sw|790|tg|Соли 790|th|พ.ศ. 1333|tk|790|tl|790|tly|790|tr|790|tt|790 ел|uk|790|ur|790ء|uz|790|vec|790|vi|790|war|790|wuu|790年|xmf|790|zh|790年|zh_min_nan|790 nî|zh_yue|790年|qid=Q31147}} ({{ill|Enryaku|de|Enryaku|es|Enryaku|fa|انریاکو|fr|Ère Enryaku|ia|Enryaku|id|Enryaku|it|Enryaku|ja|延暦|ko|엔랴쿠|pt|Enryaku|ru|Энряку (нэнго)|simple|Enryaku|sr|Енрјаку|tr|Enryaku|uk|Енряку (ненґо)|zh|延曆|zh_yue|延曆|qid=Q1373176}} 9), November — According to the {{ill|Shoku Nihongi|Q611399|qid=Q611399}}, during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Kanmu|Q314846|qid=Q314846}}, the shrine already enjoyed deep devotion from the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yamato court}} and received ritual offerings ({{ill|Hōhei|Q11445508|qid=Q11445508}}).
* {{ill|852|Q30383|qid=Q30383}} ({{ill|Ninju|Q1373077|qid=Q1373077}} 2), August — During the reign of {{ill|Emperor Montoku|ar|الإمبراطور مونتوكو|azb|مونتوکو (ایمپیراتور)|be|Імператар Мантоку|ca|Montoku Tennō|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر مۆنتۆکو|cs|Montoku|de|Montoku|es|Montoku Tennō|eu|Montoku enperadorea|fa|امپراتور مونتوکو|fr|Montoku (empereur)|he|מונטוקו|id|Montoku|it|Montoku|ja|文徳天皇|ko|몬토쿠 천황|nl|Montoku|pl|Montoku|pt|Montoku|ru|Император Монтоку|sh|Car Montoku|simple|Emperor Montoku|sl|Cesar Montoku|sv|Kejsar Montoku|sw|Montoku wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิมนโตกุ|tl|Emperador Montoku|tr|Montoku (imparator)|uk|Імператор Монтоку|vi|Thiên hoàng Montoku|yo|Emperor Montoku|zh|文德天皇|zh_min_nan|Montoku Thian-hông|qid=Q357225}}, the shrine was granted the divine rank of Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade.
* {{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}} ({{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Engi}} 5) — In the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}} under {{ill|Emperor Daigo|ar|الإمبراطور دايغو|arz|امبيرور دايجو|azb|دایقو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Daigo|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر دایگۆ|cs|Daigo|de|Daigo|el|Αυτοκράτορας Νταϊγκό|eo|Daigo (imperiestro)|es|Daigo Tennō|fa|امپراتور دایگو|fr|Daigo|id|Kaisar Daigo|it|Daigo|ja|醍醐天皇|ko|다이고 천황|ms|Maharaja Daigo|nl|Daigo (keizer)|pl|Daigo|pt|Daigo|ru|Император Дайго|sh|Car Daigo|sl|Cesar Daigo|sv|Daigo (kejsare)|sw|Daigo wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิไดโงะ|tl|Emperador Daigo|tr|Daigo (imparator)|uk|Імператор Дайґо|ur|شہنشاہ ڈائیگو|vi|Thiên hoàng Daigo|yo|Emperor Daigo|zh|醍醐天皇|zh_min_nan|Daigo Thian-hông|zh_yue|醍醐天皇|qid=Q329753}}, it was listed as one of the four shrines of Kurokawa District, Mutsu Province ({{ill|Mutsu Province|ca|Província de Mutsu|cs|Provincie Mucu|de|Provinz Mutsu|es|Provincia de Mutsu|fa|ولایت موتسو|fi|Mutsun provinssi|fr|Province de Mutsu|gl|Provincia de Mutsu|id|Provinsi Mutsu|it|Mutsu (provincia)|ja|陸奥国|ko|무쓰국|lt|Mucu žemė|nl|Mutsu (provincie)|pt|Província de Mutsu|ru|Муцу (провинция)|simple|Mutsu Province|sk|Mucu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Муцу|tr|Mutsu (vilayet)|uk|Муцу (провінція)|zh|陸奧國|zh_classical|陸奧國|zh_min_nan|Mutu-kok|zh_yue|陸奧國|qid=Q907389}}).
